name: look_in_dungeon
purpose: The dungeon Look command (ROOT dispatch_command 'L' when 0x20<location<0x29; vector 1778:07b2). Runs to the RET at a513 - Ghidra split a366/a42a/a430/a448 off it. select_target_member picks the looker (-1 aborts); with no torch (0x58a7) and no light spell (0x58a6) prints 'You see:\ndarkness.' (0x752e). Otherwise SJOG bfec select_search_cell_dungeon(facing) chooses left/right/ahead/here and sets g_dx/g_dy (0 = Pass -> return). The cell g_dungeon_map[z][dy&7][dx&7] is described after 'You see:\n' (0x7542); a hidden pit 0x61 is treated as 0x00. Fields 0x8x: 0x80 sleep (0x754c), 0x81 poison gas (0x755c), 0x82 wall of fire (0x7572), 0x83 electric (0x7584), else energy field (0x7598). 0xcx walls: style&0xf==1 'a dripping stalactite' (0x75aa), 2 'a caved in passage' (0x75c2), else rand_range(1,255)==255 -> 'an unfortunate software pirate' (0x75d8) else 'a less fortunate adventurer' (0x75fa). Other type nibbles: 0 passage 0x7618, 1 up ladder 0x7624, 2 down ladder 0x7634, 3 ladder 0x7644, 4 wooden chest 0x7650, 5 fountain 0x7662, 6 pit 0x7670, 7 open chest 0x7678, 9 nothing of note 0x769a, a heavy door 0x76ac, b wall 0x76bc, d wall 0x76d6, e heavy door 0x76e0, f heavy door 0x76f0. Fountains (0x5x) then print 'Will you drink?' (0x7700) and loop read_command_key until Y or N: N prints 'No.' (0x7712); Y prints 'Yes.  Gulp!' (0x7718) and 0x50 'Cured!' (0x7726, status byte = 'G'), 0x51 'Healed!' (0x772e, hp 0x55b8 = max hp 0x55ba), 0x52 'Poisoned!' (0x7738, status 'P'), other low nibbles 'Bad taste.' (0x7744) + damage_party_member(member, rand_range(0,7)).

0x5876.name: g_dx
0x5876.meaning: x of the looked-at cell (set by SJOG bfec)

notes: Ghidra fragments a366 (0xc0 message tail), a42a (0xf0 case + drink tail), a430 (0x30..0x60 cases), a448 (0x80..0xf0 cases + drink tail) are all this function; vectors 1778:0326/085a point into them only when NPC/SHOPPES are loaded.

name: look_fragment_a366
purpose: Not a function: the 0xcx wall-message tail of look_in_dungeon (prints caved-in passage / software pirate / less fortunate adventurer and returns). Ghidra carved it out because vector 1778:0326 (NPC a366) lands on this address. Ported as a documented no-op; the code lives in look_in_dungeon.

name: look_fragment_a42a
purpose: Not a function: the 0xf0 'a heavy door.' case of look_in_dungeon followed by the shared fountain-drink tail (vector 1778:085a = SHOPPES a42a lands here). No-op in Rust.

name: look_fragment_a430
purpose: Not a function: the 0x30 ladder / 0x40 wooden chest / 0x50 fountain / 0x60 pit cases of look_in_dungeon (entered with the type nibble in AX) plus the drink tail. No-op in Rust.

name: look_fragment_a448
purpose: Not a function: the 0x80..0xf0 cases of look_in_dungeon (energy field 0x7688, nothing of note 0x769a, heavy door 0x76ac/0x76e0/0x76f0, wall 0x76bc/0x76d6, 'SPEC WALL ERR.' 0x76c6) and the shared 'Will you drink?' tail ending at the RET at a513. No-op in Rust.

name: draw_gem_field_icon
purpose: Draws the energy-field icon of the View-gem dungeon map: eight horizontal lines from x+1 to x+6 at rows y..y+7, two rows each in g_ui_color4+8, g_ui_color0+8, g_ui_color2+8 and g_ui_color3+8 (set_color + draw_line). Ghidra param_1 = y, param_2 = x.

name: gem_map_visit_cell
purpose: One step of the View-gem flood fill over the 22x22 map display (row, col in 0..0x15, the party at 11,11). Returns 0 if out of range or g_light_map[row*0x20+col] is already 0 (visited); otherwise zeroes it, reads dungeon cell (z, (row+party_y-11)&7, (col+party_x-11)&7), puts the text cursor at (row+1, col+1), sets draw colour g_ui_color1 and draws by type nibble: 0 hall -> nothing unless bit 8 (ceiling hole): char 0x18 in g_ui_color_moon; 1/2/3 ladders -> font 1 chars 0x2e/0x2d/0x2f (moon); 4 chest -> font 1 0x70 (g_ui_color_sun); 5 fountain -> drawn with draw_line/plot_pixel at pixel (col*8, row*8) offsets 9..14 in g_ui_color1 then g_ui_color2+8; 6 pits: 0x60 -> 0x19 (font 0, moon), 0x61/0x69 -> font 1 0x71, 0x68 -> 0x12, other -> font 1 0x72 in g_ui_color0+8; 8 field -> draw_gem_field_icon(col*8+8, row*8+8); a door / f room -> font 1 0x73 (sun); b wall -> 0x7f (plain 0xb0) or font 1 0x74 (signed wall), result 0; c -> font 1 0x75 on g_ui_color2 background, result 0; d secret door -> font 1 0x76 on g_ui_color2 (CGA) / g_ui_color_moon (EGA, Tandy) background, result 0; e door -> font 1 0x77 (sun); 7 and 9 draw nothing. Always restores text colour g_ui_color1 and font 0. Returns 1 when the flood should continue through this cell.

0xad14.name: g_light_map
0xad14.meaning: reused as the visited flags of the gem map (0xff unvisited, 0 visited), stride 0x20

notes: Ghidra param_1 = row (y), param_2 = col (x); the switch default (7, 9) returns 1 without drawing.

name: view_gem_dungeon
purpose: View a gem inside a dungeon (ROOT dispatch_command 'V' when location>0x20, after the gem was consumed; vector 1778:07ca). Clears the view rectangle 8..0xb7 in colour 0, fills 0x2e0 bytes of g_light_map with 0xff (unvisited), seeds the x ring queue at 0xa528 and the y ring queue at 0xa628 (0x100 bytes each) with (11,11) and marks that cell visited (0xae7f = g_light_map[11][11] = 0). Prints the party glyph 0x60 in font 1 at text (12,12) of window 0 in g_ui_color3+8 (g_ui_color1 on Hercules). Then a breadth-first flood: for each queued cell the 8 neighbours (NW,N,NE,W,E,SW,S,SE) are passed to gem_map_visit_cell(y,x) and enqueued when it returns non-zero; the queue pointers wrap at 0xa627. Stops when the write pointer meets the read pointer, then selects window 2, wait_key(0), clears the view and calls DUNGEON 9db0 redraw_dungeon_view.

name: mark_dungeon_room_cleared
purpose: Marks room 0..15 of the current dungeon as cleared (vector 1778:04e2; DUNGEON enter_dungeon_room calls it after the COMBAT room loop returns 0, i.e. the room was won). First scans the persistent-room table: count byte at 0x3840 (6) and bytes at 0x383a (50 5b 41 46 4b 4c), each (location & 0xf) * 0x10 + room; a match returns without marking (Covetous rooms 0 and 11, Wrong rooms 1, 6, 11, 12 always respawn). Otherwise dungeon index = location - 0x21, or location - 0x22 when that is > 0 (Deceit and Despise both map to 0 - the same quirk as DUNGEON enter_dungeon_room's CBT offset), bit = index * 16 + room, and bit (bit & 7) of byte g_dungeon_rooms_cleared[bit / 8] (signed division, 0x58e0) is set.

0x383a.name: g_persistent_rooms
0x383a.meaning: (location&0xf)<<4 | room of rooms never marked cleared

notes: The xor/sub expression in the C is a signed divide by 8.

name: dungeon_room_is_cleared
purpose: Returns whether bit (dungeon_index * 16 + room) of g_dungeon_rooms_cleared is set, with the same dungeon index rule as mark_dungeon_room_cleared (location-0x21, or location-0x22 when positive).

name: apply_cleared_rooms_to_map
purpose: Vector 1778:049a, called by DUNGEON dungeon_main on entering a dungeon. Walks all 0x200 bytes of g_dungeon_map; every cell with type nibble 0xf (room) whose room number (low nibble) is cleared per dungeon_room_is_cleared is ANDed with 0xaf, i.e. becomes a 0xa0 cleared-room cell (no monsters when entered). It does not load any image files (that is load_dungeon_images / b32e).

name: combat_map_wall_side
purpose: Closes one side of the 11x11 dungeon combat map (g_light_map, 32-byte rows) with 11 bytes of 0xff (black/impassable) along the outer edge: dir 0 (N) row 0 cols 0..10, 1 (E) col 10 rows 0..10, 2 (S) row 10, 3 (W) col 0. Then, if the party's own cell is a door (own_cell_hi == 0xe0 as signed char -0x20): for dir 0 writes g_dungeon_wall_tile at g_light_map[8][5] (0xae19) and [2][5] (0xad59); for dir 3 at [5][8] (0xadbc) and [5][2] (0xadb6) - door pillars inside the corridor. Ghidra param_1 = dir, param_2 = own_cell_hi.

name: combat_map_opening5
purpose: Writes 5 g_dungeon_floor_tile bytes into the inner wall ring of the combat map, a doorway on side dir: 0 row 1 cols 3..7, 1 col 9 rows 3..7, 2 row 9 cols 3..7, 3 col 1 rows 3..7.

name: combat_map_opening7
purpose: Writes 7 g_dungeon_floor_tile bytes into the inner wall ring, an open corridor on side dir: 0 row 1 cols 2..8, 1 col 9 rows 2..8, 2 row 9 cols 2..8, 3 col 1 rows 2..8. For dir outside 0..3 the start coordinates are uninitialised stack values (callers only pass 0..3).

name: combat_map_side_from_neighbour
purpose: Shapes side dir of the dungeon combat map from the dungeon cell next to the party in that direction (y-1 / x+1 / y+1 / x-1, wrapped & 7, on g_party_z). Neighbour type < 0xa0 (hall, ladders, chest, fountain, pit, open chest, field): combat_map_opening7. Then: neighbour 0xb0 / 0xc0 / 0xd0 (walls, secret door): combat_map_wall_side(dir, own cell type<<4) - else combat_map_opening5 (so open neighbours get both gaps; doors, rooms and 0xa0 cells get only the 5-wide doorway).

0x5895.name: g_party_z
0x5895.meaning: the word read at 0x5895 is z (low) and x (high)

name: build_dungeon_combat_walls
purpose: Vector 1778:0536 and called by build_dungeon_combat_map. Draws the wall ring of the 11x11 dungeon combat map in g_light_map: rows 1 and 9 cols 0..10 and columns 1 and 9 rows 0..10 = g_dungeon_wall_tile; the four outer corners [0][0] [0][10] [10][0] [10][10] = 0xff. If the party's cell type is 1..7, g_combat_map_centre ([5][5], 0xadb9) is set from the byte table 0x244a[type] (00 c8 c9 c8 dc d8 00 00: ladder up tile 0xc8, ladder down 0xc9, two-way ladder 0xc8, chest 0xdc, fountain 0xd8; 0 = leave the floor) when non-zero; for type 3 (two-way ladder) g_tiles_patched = 1 and driver_tile_patch(0) rewrites the ladder tile rows, else g_tiles_patched = 0. Finally combat_map_side_from_neighbour(0..3) opens or closes each side.

0x244a.name: g_cell_centre_tiles
0x244a.meaning: combat-map centre tile per dungeon cell type

name: build_dungeon_combat_map
purpose: Vector 1778:04a6: DUNGEON dungeon_monster_attacks and ROOT hole_up_and_camp (dungeon camp, g_combat_flags 6) build the whole 0x160-byte CBT-format map in g_light_map before run_encounter. Rows 0..10 cols 0..10 = g_dungeon_floor_tile; a camp (flags & 4) sets the centre to tile 0xb3 (camp fire); build_dungeon_combat_walls. Side data: row 8 cols 11..26 (trigger positions) = 0xff. Party positions: row 1 ('from east') x cols 11..16 = 0x2464 (06 07 07 08 08 08), y cols 17..22 = 0x2470 (05 04 06 03 05 07); row 2 ('from west') x = 0x246a, y = 0x245e; row 3 ('from south') x = 0x2470, y = 0x2464; row 4 ('from north') x = 0x245e, y = 0x246a; a camp writes x 0x2452 (05 06 05 04 04 06) and y 0x2458 (04 05 06 05 04 06) into all four rows (huddled round the fire). Monster positions row 6 (x) / row 7 (y) cols 11..26 by g_dungeon_facing: 0 x 0x2476 y 0x2496, 1 x 0x2486 y 0x24a6, 2 x 0x24a6 y 0x2486, 3 x 0x2496 y 0x2476 (other facings write nothing); camp x 0x24b6 y 0x24c6 (ring round the party). Row 5 cols 11..26 (monster tiles) = 0 and a permutation of 0..15 is made by 16 swaps with rand_range(0,15). Monster type = monster slot 1 type byte 0x5c67, or for a camp a random entry of 0x173c (14 15 16 17 18 19 1c 1b). count = rand_range(1, g_monster_stats[type*8+5] = group size at 0x13c2), but the full group when that byte is 8 or 16; the first count permuted entries get tile 0x40 + type*4 (decoded back by setup_room_combatants).
notes: g_unk_2452/g_unk_244a in symbols.json are these tables.

name: apply_combat_exit_to_dungeon
purpose: Vector 1778:04ee, run by DUNGEON after a room or a monster fight. Moves the party by g_combat_exit: 1 (W) x-1, facing and g_dungeon_dir_copy 3, x > 7 (wrapped) -> 7; 2 (E) x+1, facing 1, x > 7 -> 0; 3 (N) y-1, facing 0, y > 7 -> 7; 4 (S) y+1, facing 2, y > 7 -> 0; 5 (up) z-1 and dir_copy 4 unless z == 0; 6 (down) z+1 and dir_copy 5 unless z == 7; leaving level 0 upward or level 7 downward calls DUNGEON 9ed8 exit_dungeon (vector 1778:051e) and sets g_location = 0. Other values: no move.

0x58a0.name: g_combat_exit
0x58a0.meaning: exit side of the combat map

0x6602.name: g_dungeon_dir_copy
0x6602.meaning: last move, 4 = came from below, 5 = from above

name: load_dungeon_images
purpose: Vector 1778:048e: (re)enter the first-person view (DUNGEON dungeon_main / after rooms and fights with 1; ROOT hole_up_and_camp with an unspecified stack value). Nothing when g_location == 0. If g_dungeon_flags & 2 the TILES.16 picture is freed (free_picture); if flags & 1 == 0, DNGn.16 (g_raw_file_names[4 + g_dungeon_style], i.e. DNG1/2/3.16 -> segment 0xa9c0) and ITEMS.16 (g_raw_file_names[4] -> 0xa9c4) are loaded with load_image_file, each retried while it returns 0. g_dungeon_flags = 1. reset_monster != 0 clears monster slot 1: 0x5c62/0x5c63 = 0, x/y 0x5c64/0x5c65 = 0xff, type 0x5c67 = 0xff. Then clears the 8..0xb7 view square on page 0 and page 1.

0xbb17.name: g_dungeon_flags
0xbb17.meaning: bit0 dungeon images loaded, bit1 TILES.16 loaded, bit2 tile patch applied

0x25f2.name: g_raw_file_names[4]
0x25f2.meaning: ITEMS.16, DNG1.16, DNG2.16, DNG3.16 name pointers

name: unload_dungeon_images
purpose: Vector 1778:0482: leave the first-person view before any combat/room/camp/exit (DUNGEON, ROOT hole_up_and_camp). If g_dungeon_flags & 1: frees MONn.16 (0xa9c6) when a monster exists (0x5c67 != 0xff), zeroes 0xa9c6, frees ITEMS.16 (0xa9c4) and DNGn.16 (0xa9c0). If flags & 2 == 0: load_picture_file(TILES.16 = g_raw_file_names[3]) retried while 0. If flags & 4 == 0: driver_tile_patch_special(0) = driver entry 36 command 3 (dungeon colour swap of the tile set). g_dungeon_flags = 6.

name: setup_room_combatants
purpose: Vector 1778:04be; runs through fragment b542 to the RET at b630. Places the party and the monsters/items of the CBT map in g_light_map. Callers: DUNGEON enter_dungeon_room(3, room cell), ROOT run_encounter(2, 0) for dungeon fights, CMDS bf80 (0 and 1). mode != 1: party start row by g_dungeon_facing (0 -> row 3 'from south', 1 -> row 2 'from west', 3 -> row 1 'from east', 5 -> row 3, else row 4 'from north'); init_combat_party; for i < g_party_count: g_roster_x[i*8] = g_monster_x[i*8] = row[11+i], g_roster_y = g_monster_y = row[17+i]. Then if mode > 0 and (mode < 3 or (mode == 3 and cell >= 0xf0, an uncleared room)): 4 random types from 0x385e (14 15 16 22 21 18 1f 18) for tiles 0xec..0xef; for each of the 16 monster tiles in row 5 cols 11..26 (x row 6, y row 7): 0 = none; tile < 0x40 or (tile & 0xfc) in {0xb4, 0xe8} -> add_combatant(z, y, x, 2, tile) (object/item); else monster add_combatant(z, y, x, 0, (tile-0x40)/4), 0xec.. using random type [tile & 3]. For mode-2 objects the quantity byte g_ship_hull[slot*8] (monster table value1) is set: value 1 -> z*3+7, 2 -> rand_range(1, z*10+10), 3..15 -> 0x384d[value] + rand_range(0, 0x383f[value]-1), > 15 untouched. Ghidra param_1 = mode, param_2 = cell.
notes: Local 0xb - 0x524c etc. in the C are g_light_map[5][11] (0xadbf), [6][11] (0xaddf), [7][11] (0xadff).

name: setup_room_fragment_b542
purpose: Not a function: the 16-entry monster/item placement loop of setup_room_combatants (Ghidra split it because vector 1778:0842 = SHOPPES b542 lands here). No-op in Rust.
